message: ALERT: Geomagnetic Storm Watch issued. G2 (Moderate) geomagnetic storm conditions expected due to CME arrival.
WARNING: M-class solar flare detected from Region 3842. M5.2 flare peaked at 06:15 UTC.
SUMMARY: S2 (Moderate) solar radiation storm in progress. Proton flux levels elevated.
WATCH: G1 (Minor) geomagnetic storm watch. High-speed solar wind stream expected.
ALERT: Coronal Mass Ejection (CME) detected. Earth-directed component estimated arrival in 48-72 hours.
